title: Customisable Peaceful Difficulty 可自訂和平模式
body:
# Customisable Peaceful Difficulty 可自訂和平模式
___
___
___
# About 關於

This datapack allows players to customise their own peaceful difficulty, via a book, including:

此指令包允許玩家透過一本書自訂自己的和平難度，包括：

  - Toggle passive monsters   - 切換怪物友好
  - Toggle hunger   - 切換飢餓
  - Toggle drowning   - 切換溺水
  - Toggle player burning   - 切換玩家抗火
  - Toggle fall damage   - 切換墜落傷害
  - Toggle full bright (Night Vision)   - 切換全亮（夜視）
  - Toggle negative effect (Poison, slowness, etc)   - 切換等負面影響（中毒、緩慢等）

---
The book will given to any players first time joining the world. The book is unbreakable, it will not despawn, burn in fire/lava, or die in explosion. In case it is lost somehow, use ```/function customisablepd:givebook```.

這本書將贈送給任何首次加入這個世界的玩家。這本書不會壞，它不會消失，不會在火/熔岩中燃燒，也不會在爆炸中消失。萬一遺失，請使用 ```/function customisablepd:givebook```。

---
Cave ambience is disabled. 

此指令包消除洞穴音效。

---
The actual game difficulty is Hard, while mobGrieving gamerule is set to false.

實際遊戲難度為困難，而 mobGrieving 遊戲規則設定為 false。

---

# Instructions 說明

This datapack is loaded automatically. 

此指令包自動載入。

---
Due to technical issue, the loaded message will not show up when loaded in the first place, it will be shown when /reload is used.

由於技術問題，載入訊息在第一次載入時不會顯示，而是在使用/reload時顯示。

---
Due to technical issue, uninstalling is currently impossible.

由於技術問題，目前無法卸載。

---
